status: draft_from_steam_pilot_reading; revise after the 50-review annotation pilot and overlap adjudication
source_note: Terms were chosen by reading the 200-review steam_pilot.jsonl (5 Valve games). They are candidate cues for the extractor baseline and examples for annotators, not an exhaustive or validated vocabulary.

gameplay.definition: Core play experience: mechanics, controls, combat/gunplay, puzzles, heroes/classes/weapons, strategy, depth, difficulty, pacing, game balance and replayability.

modes_content.definition: Amount and kind of content: maps, levels, campaign, game modes (co-op, versus, casual, ranked as a mode), game length, workshop/mods/community maps.

story_characters.definition: Narrative and writing: story, plot, lore, characters, dialogue, humor, voice acting, ending.

audiovisual.definition: Presentation: graphics, visuals, art style, animation, music, sound effects, soundtrack, gore effects.

performance_stability.definition: Technical quality on the player's machine or network: FPS, stutter, optimization, crashes, bugs, connection/server reliability, system requirements.

matchmaking_ranking.definition: How matches are formed and ranked: matchmaking, queue times, ranked/MMR/Elo systems, team balance, smurfs and boosters as a matchmaking-fairness issue.

players_community.definition: Other people and the social experience: teammates, toxicity, the community, playing with friends or randoms.

cheating_moderation.definition: Integrity and enforcement: cheaters/hackers, bot accounts, anti-cheat (VAC), bans, reports, behavior/communication scores, penalties, vote kicks.

developer_support.definition: The developer/publisher's ongoing support: updates, patches, fixes, neglect or abandonment, customer support.

value_monetization.definition: Price and spending: price/value for money, free-to-play, skins/cosmetics, cases, gambling, paid subscriptions, microtransactions.

special_labels.overall: Whole-game judgment with no specific aspect ('great game', '10/10'). Annotate it, but report it separately and exclude it from aspect P/R/F1 and from O(u,i).
special_labels.none: Use once per review that has no aspect and no overall judgment, so the review counts as annotated (needed for precision/recall denominators).
